operations.description: Remove one or ten percent per shell cycle without reducing shell precursor doses. Withdraw 1% or 10% after each complete shell cycle but retain the original precursor doses. Both reduce precipitation; the larger withdrawal almost eliminates it but gives poor QY and misshapen particles. Lesser withdrawal gives rods or irregular particles. Missing fields: full per-layer accounting. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.

Combine 1% withdrawals with 2.5-fold more OA per layer starting at the fifth to eighth shell. Thick-shell QY reaches 50% with symmetric spherical/hexagonal particles, while precipitation returns.
